issues.detail: Hebrew 'לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם' means 'according to their tribes' (by their tribes), but Chinese renders it as '按他們的杖' ('according to their staff/rod'), which misrepresents the meaning. The Hebrew word 'שֵׁבֶט' can mean 'tribe' or 'staff/rod'; here it clearly means 'tribes' in context (giving land to the house of Israel by their tribes), not 'staff'.
